en.answer:
Yes, you can.

In that case, the opponent cannot choose to pay 2000 Life Points when it resolves, so the effect will resolve as normal when no Life Points is paid.
en.question: If the effect of my opponent's <<7770>> is applying, or I have activated <<5637>> this turn, can I activate <<16881>> despite not being able to Set Trap Cards?
en.title: Can <<16881>> be activated when the opponent cannot Set cards?

ja.answer:
できます。

その場合、相手はその処理時に２０００LPを払うことができません。『払わなかった場合』の処理を行うことになります。
